title: OpenSRO server
description: The game server's health, players, gateway, loops, world, combat, economy, database and Go runtime (round 858).

panels.title: Up
panels.description: 1 when a sample arrived from the server in the last minute.

panels.title: Version
panels.description: The running build (opensro_build_info).

panels.title: Errors / min
panels.description: ERROR log lines a minute.

panels.title: Panics (1h)
panels.description: Panics recovered in the last hour (a handler, a disconnect hook, the COS tick).

panels.title: Worst loop p99
panels.description: The slowest loop's p99 tick over 5 minutes.

panels.title: Overruns / min
panels.description: Ticks longer than their loop's period.

panels.title: Stalest loop
panels.description: Seconds since the least recently ticked loop (mover excluded: it sleeps while nobody moves). Above 30 s the server is stuck.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: Cores used (1 = 100% of one core).

panels.title: Sched latency p99
panels.description: How long a runnable goroutine waited for a thread: high means CPU-starved.

panels.title: Mover lock hold
panels.description: How long the last mover pass held the world hub's write lock.

panels.title: Players online by zone
panels.description: The zone is the named town whose area the player stands in (nearest town centre in the one world frame), a dungeon, or other.

panels.title: Logins by result
panels.description: Login decisions a minute (both wires).

panels.title: Disconnects by reason
panels.description: Sessions ended a minute.

panels.title: World entries, lobby ops
panels.description: A minute.

panels.title: Handler p99 by group
panels.description: The handler chain's time over one inbound packet.

panels.title: Handler errors and panics / min
panels.description: Each one closed the player's session.

panels.title: Top inbound opcodes (rate over the range)

targets.expr: topk(15, sum by (opcode, group) (rate(opensro_gateway_packets_total{job="opensro-server", instance=~"$instance", dir="in"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Top outbound opcodes (rate over the range)

targets.expr: topk(15, sum by (opcode, group) (rate(opensro_gateway_packets_total{job="opensro-server", instance=~"$instance", dir="out"}[$__range])))
